errors.text: The proposed Al10Co25Cr8Fe15Ni36Ti6 alloy is not a refractory high-entropy alloy, so the hypothesis is misaligned with the requested material class.
No supporting prior evidence is cited.
The intervention does not reconstruct the target processing-and-coating strategy and does not identify a specific silicide coating responsible for oxidation protection.
The claimed stable-oxide and oxygen-diffusion mechanism is asserted without identifying the oxide chemistry or explaining the potentially adverse oxidation behavior of molybdenum.
